description: This file implements training functionalities for machine learning models, including data preprocessing, model training, performance evaluation, and artifact storage. It provides an API for users to upload dataset files and automatically train and store models, with support for different file formats like CSV and Excel.

classes.name: TrainingResult
classes.description: Structured result of a training operation, including model ID, path, task type, target column, metrics, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: str _infer_task_type(y: pd.Series)
methods.description: Infers whether the ML task is classification or regression based on target variable properties.

methods.name: Tuple[pd.DataFrame,pd.Series] _prepare_features(df: pd.DataFrame, target_column: str)
methods.description: Prepares feature matrix X and target vector y from a DataFrame, handling missing values, encoding, and feature selection.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _read_uploaded_to_dataframe(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str)
methods.description: Reads uploaded file bytes into a pandas DataFrame supporting CSV and Excel formats.

methods.name: _train_model(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series, task_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Trains a Random Forest model for classification or regression, returns the trained model and metrics.

methods.name: _to_json_safe(value)
methods.description: Converts numpy types and NaN to JSON-safe Python types.

methods.name: TrainingResult _store_artifact(model, meta: Dict[str, Union[str, int, float]])
methods.description: Stores the trained model using joblib and saves metadata as JSON, returning a TrainingResult.

methods.name: TrainingResult train_from_upload( file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, target_column: Optional[str] = None, task_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Main public function to train a model from uploaded dataset bytes, performing data reading, preprocessing, training, and storage.
